assessment_scope: All 12 source/title repairs and four physical-site holds from the 169 candidate admission board
critical_distinctions: No new Place approved or inserted
La Popa's Candelaria church on hill differs from lower Candelaria hermitage
Baruny now has documented diocesan Roman Catholic worship as of October 2025; historical Uniate heritage remains distinct
St Peregrine shrine is an association of Our Lady of Sorrows Basilica; one physical Place, not two
Existing Mongomo basilica must not be confused with Ciudad de la Paz planned cathedral
Isiro new grand shrine site is construction scope only
Names in corrected_display_name are owner-review proposals, not renamed canonical Place records

records.corrected_display_name: Basilica of Saint Michael, Marian Pilgrimage Church of Absam
records.correction_note: The parish identifies the pilgrimage image within St Michael's parish basilica. The municipal authority confirms basilica status since 2000; one existing church building, not an apparition-window Place.
records.safety_caution: Church point near parish basilica; do not pin original apparition house as a second church.

records.corrected_display_name: Sanctuary of Our Lady Consoler of the Afflicted, Baruny
records.correction_note: Catholic diocesan reporting records current 2025 celebrations at the Baruny diocesan Marian shrine and 2024 image coronation. Historical Basilian Greek-Catholic/Uniate provenance is retained separately; present-day Roman Catholic parish use is documented.
records.safety_caution: Only a locality-scale anchor is supplied; no independently certified church entrance.

records.previous_proposed_name: Shrine of Our Lady of the Rosary, La Popa, Cartagena
records.corrected_display_name: Church and Convent of Santa Cruz de La Popa (Our Lady of Candelaria)
records.correction_note: Cartagena officially distinguishes hilltop Convento y Santuario Santa Cruz-La Popa, housing the image of the Virgin of Candelaria, from the lower Ermita de La Candelaria in Pie de la Popa. The inherited Our Lady of the Rosary dedication is incorrect.
records.safety_caution: Change owner-facing title to Candelaria; do not assign the lower parish church as the hilltop pin.

records.previous_proposed_name: National Shrine of Saint Barbara, Havana
records.corrected_display_name: Parish of Saint Barbara, Párraga, Havana
records.correction_note: The Archdiocese of Havana lists Parroquia de Santa Bárbara at Calixto García and Hatuey, Párraga. Formal National Shrine designation is not established by its directory; omit the unsupported rank from display.
records.safety_caution: Owner must approve the corrected parish-level title before entry, with no claim of national canonical designation.

records.previous_proposed_name: National Shrine of Divine Mercy, Guayaquil
records.corrected_display_name: Sanctuary of the Lord of Divine Mercy, Guayaquil
records.correction_note: The Guayaquil archdiocesan directory names Santuario del Señor de la Divina Misericordia at km 26 Vía a la Costa. A third-party GCatholic page says National Shrine, but that adjective is not confirmed by the official directory; use the official neutral name.
records.safety_caution: Retain site address and source-scoped shrine identity; do not silently assert National or a GPS-exact door.

records.previous_proposed_name: Basilica of Our Lady of the Miracles, Ágreda
records.corrected_display_name: Minor Basilica of Our Lady of the Miracles, Ágreda
records.correction_note: The parish itself explicitly calls the site Basílica de Nuestra Señora de los Milagros and records the title of minor basilica and aggregation to Lateran in 1932; physical site is former Augustinian church, not missing convent.
records.safety_caution: Locality-level point only until accepted; distinguish the surviving basilica from demolished Augustinian monastery.

records.corrected_display_name: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
records.correction_note: Patrimonio Nacional's full readable visitor page identifies the royal monastery and describes basilica, royal pantheon, library, palace and museum facilities as one heritage complex.
records.safety_caution: Mark as monumental abbey/royal heritage precinct, not a separate basilica building pin or proof of a traditional Mass schedule.

records.correction_note: Dijon Diocese confirms the cathedral Saint-Bénigne at Place Saint-Bénigne, Dijon, separately from parish secretariat at 6 rue Danton. Original record's failed fetch is superseded by readable direct diocesan page.
records.safety_caution: Never place cathedral at parish office address; proposed site point remains illustrative.

records.previous_proposed_name: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Remete, Zagreb
records.corrected_display_name: Shrine of Our Lady of Remete, Zagreb
records.correction_note: Zagreb Archdiocese explicitly describes Svetište Majke Božje Remetske and the historical church/monastery at Česmičkoga 1. The page notes 2020 earthquake damage and rebuilding; do not assert current sanctuary-church access without a separate current opening check.
records.safety_caution: Church, Carmelite monastery and interim liturgical building are distinct internal features of one shrine precinct.

records.previous_proposed_name: Our Lady of Tsuwano, Otome Pass
records.correction_note: Shimane prefectural tourism describes Otome Toge Maria Chapel at Otome Pass, not Tsuwano parish church. Independent local map feature near 34.473075,131.770838 is approximately 68 m from staged point. Legends about Marian appearances must be attributed as traditions, never authenticated apparitions.
records.safety_caution: Change owner-facing name and identity source. Pin only Otome Pass chapel at illustrative site precision.

records.corrected_display_name: Franciscan Church of Saint Lazarus, Bethany (al-Eizariya)
records.correction_note: The Franciscan Custody's 2026 liturgical report explicitly names the Church of Saint Lazarus in Bethany and distinguishes liturgy in Lazarus's Tomb crypt and subsequent pilgrim stops. Church is a real separately named building within the holy-sites complex.
records.safety_caution: Pin Franciscan church not tomb crypt/Greek Orthodox church/whole village unless point precision matches.

records.previous_proposed_name: Santuário Nossa Senhora da Conceição da Muxima
records.corrected_display_name: Sanctuary of Our Lady of the Conception, Muxima
records.correction_note: Diocese of Viana confirms church reopening and altar dedication on 13 July 2026, following renovation; dedicated shrine entry locates it in Vila da Muxima, Quissamã. Earlier fetch limitation has been resolved by readable primary-source material.
records.safety_caution: Preserve locality precision; source establishes sanctuary location in village, not precise doorway geometry.

records.previous_proposed_name: Saint Catherine Latin Catholic Cathedral, Alexandria
records.corrected_display_name: Saint Catherine Roman Catholic Cathedral, Alexandria
records.correction_note: OSM way 655944901 labels Saint Catherine Cathedral as Roman Catholic church building at 31.19455,29.89471; independent address record gives 3 Place Sainte Catherine in Alexandria, not the Coptic or Greek Orthodox cathedrals.
records.safety_caution: Original 31.194753,29.894503 staged site point is approximately 30 m from OSM footprint centroid, adequate for illustrative review only.

records.previous_proposed_name: Basilica of the Immaculate Conception, Mongomo
records.corrected_display_name: Cathedral Basilica of the Immaculate Conception, Mongomo
records.correction_note: OSM way 496238151 labels the Catholic cathedral basilica at 1.62257,11.29871; Vatican documents papal Mass at the existing Mongomo basilica on 22 April 2026, distinct from the future Ciudad de la Paz cathedral.
records.safety_caution: Staged locality point lies approximately 52 m from mapped basilica; preserve locality/complex illustrative scope, not an entrance or future cathedral.

records.previous_proposed_name: National Shrine of Saint Peregrine, Chicago
records.corrected_display_name: Our Lady of Sorrows Basilica — National Shrine of Saint Peregrine, Chicago
records.correction_note: Archdiocese of Chicago's parish directory places the National Shrine of St Peregrine within Our Lady of Sorrows Basilica at 3121 W Jackson Blvd. Its operator confirms a single basilica site with Peregrine devotions. The 535-Place draft does not contain this Chicago basilica; create at most one physical Place, with the shrine as an associated dedication.
records.safety_caution: No second church pin for St Peregrine; if basilica is admitted, name one physical site and associate the devotion with it, never infer TLM.

records.previous_proposed_name: National Shrine of Blessed Anuarite, Isiro
records.corrected_display_name: National Shrine of Blessed Anuarite — planned new building, Isiro
records.correction_note: CENCO says works on the new grand shrine were launched 1 Dec 2025; state reporting identifies the new project on former Isiro military airfield land. Existing pilgrim commemorations and the saint's remains at Isiro cathedral do not establish the new building as completed or its footprint.
records.safety_caution: Keep new-building site unpublished/owner-unreviewable until an existing worship location is explicitly differentiated from the construction project and its site point corroborated.
